study: TAKE: a taker IOC when Revolut X's GBP stablecoin book rests through a rung of PR5's rule, simulated with the live executor's own fill, fee, penny and exit rules on Revolut X's recorded UK books (agent_book_levels, QUEUE's deviation 1). In-sample and exploratory: paper minutes 2026-09-26 18:30 -> 2026-10-03 02:00 UTC (lit Monday 09-28 to Friday 10-02), at £50 and £100 a rung. Nothing of rule D, PR5V or rule D's twin was read.
write_up: reference §4 item 52; docs/agents/reviews/2026-10-03-take-prereg.md (the forward test it proposes); docs/LEDGER.md item 4
run: python3 study.py          # -> results.json, byte-identical on re-run (about 2 s); checks every input against its hash
python3 study.py takes    # the takes' (book, minute) keys that query M reads
python3 study.py power    # the forward bar's power: {0: 0.069, 5: 0.493, 8: 0.768, 10: 0.894, 16: 0.994} (bps a trip)
